tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

tools.name: read-document
tools.description: Read a Word document as markdown (default) or HTML. Returns prose, not structure — use list-paragraphs when you need indices to edit.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: get-document-info
tools.description: Get a Word document's OneDrive metadata, its Word document properties, and its paragraph and word counts.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: list-paragraphs
tools.description: List a Word document's paragraphs with the stable indices that append-paragraphs, delete-paragraph, and the other edit tools target. Call this before editing to find the paragraph you mean. Text inside tables is not listed and cannot be targeted by index.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

tools.name: get-comments
tools.description: Read the review comments in a Word document, with their authors and dates. Returns an empty list when the document has none.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

tools.name: create-document
tools.description: Create a new Word document from structured paragraphs. Fails if a file already exists at the path unless overwrite is set — an existing document is not recoverable from here except through OneDrive version history.

path.description: Destination path relative to the drive root, ending in .docx. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

paragraphs.description: The document body, in order. Each entry is { text, style?, bold?, italic? }; style may be Heading1, Heading2, or Heading3.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at this path. Defaults to false, which fails instead.

tools.name: replace-text
tools.description: Replace text in a Word document, matching text as the reader sees it even when Word has split it across formatting runs. Text inside tables is not searched or replaced. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

search.description: Exact text to find. Not a regular expression.

replacement.description: Text to put in its place. May be empty to delete.

paragraphIndex.description: Optional paragraph index from list-paragraphs. Omit to replace throughout the document.

tools.name: append-paragraphs
tools.description: Add paragraphs to the end of a Word document, leaving everything already there untouched. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

paragraphs.description: Paragraphs to append, in order. Each is { text, style? }.

tools.name: delete-paragraph
tools.description: Delete one paragraph from a Word document by its index from list-paragraphs. Indices shift after a delete, so re-list before deleting again. Cannot delete table content. Recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

paragraphIndex.description: Zero-based paragraph index, as reported by list-paragraphs.

tools.name: insert-table
tools.description: Append a table to a Word document. Rows are plain strings; the first can be styled as a header. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

rows.description: Table contents as an array of rows, each an array of cell strings. Every row must have the same number of cells.

headerRow.description: Render the first row in bold as a header. Defaults to false.

tools.name: insert-page-break
tools.description: Append a page break to a Word document, so subsequent content starts on a new page. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

tools.name: insert-image
tools.description: Embed a PNG or JPEG image at the end of a Word document. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

imageBase64.description: The image bytes, base64-encoded. PNG or JPEG.

fileName.description: Name to store the image under inside the document, e.g. "chart.png". No directory separators.

widthInches.description: Displayed width in inches. Defaults to 3.

heightInches.description: Displayed height in inches. Defaults to 2.

tools.name: update-document-properties
tools.description: Set a Word document's title, author, subject, or description — the properties Word shows in File → Info. Leaves the document body untouched. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

tools.name: convert-to-pdf
tools.description: Convert a Word document to PDF and save it to OneDrive. Fails if a file already exists at the destination unless overwrite is set.

itemId.description: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path, but requires destinationPath since there is no name to derive one from.

path.description: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

destinationPath.description: Where to save the PDF. Defaults to the source path with its extension changed to .pdf.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at the destination. Defaults to false, which fails.
